articleTitle: How to Restart a Skincare Routine After Years of Nothing
imageHeadline: Restart your skincare routine from zero
imageSubtext: A gentle 3-step foundation when executive function is low
pinTitle: How to Restart a Skincare Routine After Years of Nothing | Depression & Neurodivergence
pinDescription: Depression and neurodivergence can derail self-care for years. Learn how to rebuild a simple, sustainable skincare routine that works with your brain—starting with just three steps: cleanser, moisturizer, and sunscreen. Includes strategies for ADHD, trauma, and low-energy days.

items.label: Add a gentle cleanser in the shower
Keep moisturizer where you already go daily
Layer in sunscreen after it feels automatic

backgroundScene: A simple bathroom counter with a few skincare bottles beside a sink, soft natural light coming through a window, clean and uncluttered
